correctness.rationale: The exact Fourier transform of each ball has radial Bessel order d/2 with stated 2pi convention. Squared fixed-order Bessel expansion gives the r^{d-1}/pi^2 envelope; normalized angular interference equals Gamma(d/2)(2/z)^{d/2-1}J_{d/2-1}(z)=O(z^{-(d-1)/2}), proving the uniform additive remainder. Kronecker equidistribution supplies the irrational distribution and extrema. In the rational case the compact phase orbit has a simultaneous cosine zero iff the Bezout integer equation qk-pell=(p-q)(d+3)/4 is soluble, exactly the asserted congruence; the maximum uses d+1. The three-dimensional ratio 1:2 reduces exactly to 16(z-15/32)^2+31/64 and maximizes at z=1. The independently rerun CHECK.py gave 4273 finite supplementary assertions; none substitutes for the all-parameter proof.
